era: GiveSendGo 2019 home page (Wayback captures Mar, Jul and Nov 2019, rendered with their CSS): white header with the logo, Search, Discover, Categories, green 'Start a GiveSendGo' and Login, 'Our Givers' ticker, Trending Campaigns cards with a green progress bar, Campaign Map, Categories tiles (Mission, Medical, Memorial, Family, Community, Church), Testimonies and a dark footer with Pricing and Fees, Common questions, Blog, Contact Us, Terms, Privacy, email signup and Facebook / Twitter / Pinterest / Google+ / YouTube. GiveSendGo had no dark design.
